name: EHR Design System
description: Design tokens extracted from the EHR dashboard concept (Ehr.) — light, soft, blue-accented medical timeline UI.

source.method: Pixel-sampled with Pillow (region mode + darkest-1%); layout values measured visually. Entries marked "estimated" were not cleanly sampleable — verify against the Figma/source before relying on them.

provenance.color.accent: sampled (mode of blue icon circles #0067FD, most-saturated card pixel #0067FF)
provenance.color.darkSurface: sampled (nav pill mode #4F4F4F, year pill #525152 — glass card reads #4A5258 over blue)
provenance.typography.family: estimated — geometric sans with single-story 'a' (Century Gothic / Futura class); Poppins is the closest Google font. Confirm exact family.

choice.note: Multiple-choice option colors — Google brand hues, tone-matched to our accent's vibrancy; shapes keep options distinguishable (color never speaks alone). True = green, False = red (white large text passes AA-large).

typography.family: Questrial, Poppins, 'Century Gothic', Futura, system-ui, sans-serif

usage.display: Page titles (Overview / Patient Health) — regular weight, never bold
usage.number: Large metrics (47, 74) on dark measurement cards — light weight
usage.title: Card titles (Vital Signs, Records)

elevation.none: none — dark and blue surfaces carry no shadow

iconography.style: thin-line icons, round caps and joins

motion.notes: Assumed (not observable in stills): hover lift on circles, connector draw-in on load

pillNav.multiActive: filter variants (Docs/Labs/Imaging/Medications) may all be dark at once
pillNav.search: white pill with leading magnifier icon, text.muted placeholder

featureCardAccent.actions: white 36px circles with accent icons; ↗ open button top-right

metricCard.header: icon circle + title + muted subtitle + ↗ float button
metricCard.sparkline: 2px accent stroke over diagonal hatch band (color.hatch stripes on white), dotted vertical cursor, value right-aligned + micro unit

timeline.eventMarker: accent circle (36–44px) with white line icon; clusters may overlap
timeline.yearRail: vertical darkSurface pill with white dots + year labels

nodeCard.layout: icon circle + title (node) + muted subtitle + meta date right
nodeCard.variants: medication (pill icon + dosage), document, imaging (16px-radius thumbnail), lab (sparkline)

measurementCard.bg: dark, photo thumbnail full-bleed with dark scrim
measurementCard.content: number (40px light, white) + label + micro timestamp (e.g. '8.02') + ↗ white circle

doctorRow.count: 32px white circle with number (elevation.float); blue mini-badge variant with white 10px number

wordmark.text: 'Ehr.' — medium weight with trailing period as brand signature

principles: Light-first: gray canvas, white cards; color is reserved for meaning (accent blue = active/medical event).
Two anchors only: vivid blue + dark charcoal; everything else is neutral gray scale.
Circles and pills everywhere — no sharp corners; buttons are circles, nav is pills.
Thin 1.5px line icons never float bare; they live inside circles.
Color never speaks alone: blue markers pair with icons + labels.
Light weights carry the display type; hierarchy comes from size, not boldness.

changelog.change: Initial extraction from the three EHR screenshots: 53 core tokens across 7 categories (color 15, typography 13, radius 5, spacing 7, elevation 3, iconography 6, motion 4) plus 14 component recipes. Colors pixel-sampled; font family flagged for confirmation.

Refinement pass (user-confirmed): surface #E8E8E8 → #EDEDED; text.muted #9EA2A8 → #565F6C (much darker secondary text); dot #E7E7E9 → #D1D1D1. NEW tokens — choice colors (Google hues, our tone): red #EA4335, yellow #FBBC05 (ink icon — white fails on yellow), green #34A853; blue = accent #0A89FF. True/False buttons: TRUE = green, FALSE = red (white large text, AA-large ok). UX decision: admin is accessible ONLY at /admin — the home page drops the admin gate and the 'Recorded data' link (admin function unchanged; when applied to the real app, home keeps server-driven lists only for a verified admin token and 'Create a quiz' redirects to /admin when signed out). Token count 53 → 56.

User-adjusted baseline from the preview.html test drive (confirmed as the new reference). Changes from v1.0.0 — canvas #EEEEEE → #FFFFFF; surface #F5F5F5 → #E8E8E8 (inverted: white canvas, gray surface); accent #0067FF → #0A89FF (lighter azure); radius.card 24 → 37 and radius.cardLg 28 → 26 (cards now rounder than large cards — kept as chosen); radius.thumb 16 → 17; size.display 44 → 46; size.number 40 → 38; size.title 20 → 28; font Poppins → Questrial (single-weight 400 — the 300 'light' for big numbers is no longer real; browser may synthesize). Unchanged: card #FFFFFF, dark surfaces, text grays, dot/hatch, overlay/skeleton, spacing, elevation, iconography, motion. Original v1.0.0 sampled values preserved in this entry for rollback.
